revelation.8.p1.b1.text: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

revelation.8.p2.b2.text: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and they were given seven trumpets.

revelation.8.p2.b3.text: Then another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. …

revelation.8.p2.b4.text: And the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of the saints, rose up before God from the hand of the angel.

revelation.8.p2.b5.text: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it to the earth; and there were peals of thunder, and rumblings, and flashes of lightning, and an earthquake.

revelation.8.p3.b6.text: And the seven angels with the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.

revelation.8.p3.b7.text: Then the first angel sounded his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood were hurled down upon the earth.

revelation.8.p3.b8.text: A third of the earth was burned up, along with a third of the trees and all the green grass.

revelation.8.p4.b9.text: Then the second angel sounded his trumpet, and something like a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,

revelation.8.p4.b10.text: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.

revelation.8.p5.b11.text: Then the third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star burning like a torch fell from heaven

revelation.8.p5.b12.text: and landed on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.

revelation.8.p5.b13.text: … A third of the waters turned bitter like wormwood oil, and many people died from the bitter waters.

revelation.8.p6.b14.text: Then the fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and a third of the sun and moon and stars were struck.

revelation.8.p6.b15.text: A third of the stars were darkened, a third of the day was without light, and a third of the night as well.

revelation.8.p7.b16.text: And as I observed, I heard an eagle flying overhead, calling in a loud voice,

revelation.8.p7.b17.text: “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the remaining three angels!”
